name: Midoriya Yukino
source:
Tatsuki's mother. She is shorter than both Tatsuki and Tappei. Her gentle, big-hearted nature makes it clear that Tatsuki takes care of his mother. As someone capable of skillfully handling Tappei, they make good for a married couple.

[From [url=http://tvtropes.org/pmwiki/pmwiki.php/Characters/Morenatsu]TV Tropes[/url]]
